newsitem.title: UK: Sterling-driven UK grain futures close unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Sterling-driven UK grain futures close unchanged.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures closed near unchanged after a recovery from earlier lows, traders said.
"The tone was 100 percent currency inspired," one trader said.

Prices fell in early trade as sterling held onto recent gains. The fall was fuelled by some country sellers, back in the market after the New Year break, who moved to lock in prices, fearing further falls.
But later, as sterling weakened against other European currencies, wheat futures recovered. "The sellers ran for the hills," the trader said.
Front month January, the most active with 54 lots changing hands, last traded unchanged at 95 stg, having seen a low of 94.30.
Total volume was a quiet 162 lots.
Barley traded just 11 lots, 10 of them on March, which last traded down 0.50 stg at 94.50 stg.
